headline: Idle, twice running — and proven idle, not stalled
lede: Session 51 walked the claim ladder live: no halt, no steer, no next, empty game-queue, no pushed-branch corpse, both QA streams busy, and flagshipStage() null with all four flagship README gaps CLOSED-marked (parseGaps verified through the library). The forge parked honestly a second time; the two dry sessions sit one short of the rule-4 stall trip, and the only thing between the builder and a game is a queue label.

notes.text: Rule-4 countdown is live: ROBOT LAB stage 3 (#1237) was the last game merge; sessions 50 and 51 shipped none. One more dry session must report STALLED unless Jon labels #1144 (FLOOR BOSS) or #1127 (Wizardry crawler) — the trust gate is the single blocker (#1240, due Oct 31).

Idle was derived, not asserted: `flagshipStage()` and `parseGaps` run live against the four flagship READMEs plus open QA issues — SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst have zero open gaps (#959…#1035), and both QA MASTER streams hold the feedback lane, so no borrow either.
Session 50's shift notes never reached the page — the local notes file existed but nothing was pushed. Pushes are now verified by fetching the raw report.json, not by trusting a file on disk.
